questions.question: In a song sung in Judah, why does God keep a person with a steady mind in perfect peace?

answers.text: Because the person trusts in God
Because the person has no enemies
Because the person never makes mistakes

questions.question: In a song sung in Judah, why are God's people told to trust in the LORD forever?

answers.text: Because He is the Rock eternal
Because He gives His people riches
Because He keeps His people from pain
